Hi Oliver — thanks for sending that over and for the constructive call. Appreciation to your team.

Proposal from our side:
- 50% goodwill credit applied as a credit memo against your next monthly invoice (immediate action by our billing ops).
- Remaining 50% issued as a one-time wire refund once we receive: (1) certified EU VAT registration (you attached) and (2) a signed tax residency attestation (simple one-page form).

What we need from you now: the signed attestation (I can forward a template) and beneficiary details for the wire. Once Ben signs off on the GL coding, we will draft the credit memo (redwood_goodwill_memo.pdf) and share the document for your records.

Because this crosses jurisdictions, our accounting needs the VAT cert on file before cash refunds are released. If Ember prefers, we can instead do 100% as a credit memo — tell us which you prefer and we’ll fast-track.

On process: Laura will coordinate the credit memo issuance and Ben will coordinate the payment batch and GL codes. I’ll loop finance ops if we need approvals beyond the standard threshold.

Thanks — I’ll send the attestation template and a draft memo later today.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Sr. Revenue Ops Manager | Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.com
